title: A Survey on Stereotype Detection in Natural Language Processing
findings: The survey identifies religion as a key dimension for stereotype detection research, alongside race and gender. It notes that some benchmark datasets like StereoSet and HASPEEDE2 explicitly measure religious stereotypes, with a focus on groups like Muslims. The paper also highlights real-world examples of increased online hate towards Jewish and Muslim communities, underscoring the importance of this research area. However, the survey's analysis suggests that gender bias receives more attention overall than religious bias in the reviewed literature.
